signup.title: Create your account
signup.subtitle: Next you will create an organization or accept an invitation.

onboarding.title: Create your organization
onboarding.subtitle: It is the space where your team manages job ads and applications. You will be its owner.
onboarding.name: Organization name
onboarding.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes. Derived from the name, you can edit it.

dashboard.title: Overview
dashboard.subtitle: The job ads of {organization} at a glance.
dashboard.careersBody: Published job ads appear here, with salary and selection process visible to everyone.
dashboard.startIntro: Three steps to put your first transparent job ad online.

job.title: Write your first job ad
job.body: Salary range and process stages are required: without them the ad cannot be published.

publish.title: Publish it
publish.body: It appears on the careers page with the response time you declared.

team.title: Invite the people who hire with you
team.body: Every team action is kept in the audit log.

dashboard.teamBody: Invite colleagues and choose their role. Every action is kept in the log.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Who is part of {organization} and with which role.
members.inviteHint: They will get an invitation to join with the chosen role.
members.noInvitePermission: Your role does not allow inviting people.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Everything that happened in {organization}, most recent first. The log cannot be edited.
audit.loadFailed: We could not load the audit log.
audit.forbidden: You do not have permission to read the audit log.

invitation.title: Invitation to join {organization}
invitation.subtitle: You will join as {role}.
invitation.notPending: This invitation is no longer valid ({status}).

validation.passwordMin: The password must be at least 10 characters
validation.slug: Lowercase letters, numbers and single dashes only

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again shortly.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists
errors.slugTaken: This short address is already taken
errors.alreadyInvited: This person already has a pending invitation
errors.alreadyMember: This person is already part of the organization
errors.invitationWrongRecipient: This invitation is addressed to another email
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do that
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many requests, try again shortly
errors.unreachable: The service is not reachable right now

rules.salary_max_below_min: The maximum cannot be lower than the minimum
rules.city_required: Add the city: the job is not fully remote
rules.onsite_days_required: Add how many days per week are spent on site
rules.too_few_stages: Add at least one stage to the selection process
rules.too_few_responsibilities: At least three responsibilities are needed
rules.too_few_requirements: Add at least one must-have requirement

validation.invalidChoice: Pick one of the listed values
validation.stageIncomplete: Every stage needs a type, a duration and who conducts it

errors.conflict: The ad is closed and can no longer be edited
errors.validationFailed: The ad does not meet the publishing requirements
errors.loadFailed: We could not load the ad.

list.title: Jobs
list.subtitle: The job ads of {organization}: drafts, published and closed.
list.emptyBody: Create the first one: it starts as a draft and is published once it has everything it needs.
list.emptyFiltered: No job ads with this status.

draft.title: No drafts
draft.body: Every ad starts as a draft and stays one until it has a salary, a process and response times.

published.title: No published ads
published.body: When a draft is ready, publish it from the editor and it shows up on the careers page right away.

closed.title: No closed ads
closed.body: Closed ads stay here as a history, they are never deleted.

list.forbidden: You do not have permission to see job ads.

editor.readOnly: Read-only: your role cannot edit job ads.
editor.closedNote: This ad is closed and can no longer be edited. To post it again, create a new one from a template.
editor.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
editor.templateMissing: The requested template no longer exists: starting from a blank ad.
editor.publishedNote: This ad is published and can still be edited, as long as it keeps meeting the publishing requirements.

hints.salary: Gross amounts, in whole units. With a yearly period this is the gross annual salary.
hints.responseDays: Days within which the candidate hears back after each stage.
hints.process: The order is what candidates will read and what becomes the pipeline.
hints.responsibilities: At least three, one per line.
hints.mustHave: What is really needed to start. One per line.
hints.niceToHave: What would be a plus but is not required.
hints.culture: How the team works and which values matter.

list.placeholder: Type and press Enter for the next item

process.empty: No stages yet. Add at least the first one.

checklist.title: What is missing to publish
checklist.ready: All requirements are met: the ad can be published.

gaps.title: The ad has no title yet
gaps.salary: The salary is missing: add it to publish
gaps.salaryMax: The maximum salary is missing: candidates need the range
gaps.process: No stages yet: describe the selection process to publish
gaps.responseDays: Response time is missing: state it to publish
gaps.responsibilities: At least three responsibilities are needed
gaps.mustHave: Add at least one required skill

optional.summary: Add a short introduction to the role
optional.benefits: Add benefits: candidates look for them
optional.growth: Tell how people grow in this role

preview.vagueOpen: Vague phrase, see the suggested rewrite

quality.title: Ad quality
quality.hint: The analysis runs only when you ask (or when you publish): a model call costs money, so it does not run on every keystroke.
quality.needsTitle: At least a title is needed to analyse.
quality.below: Below the recommended threshold. It does not block publishing, but improving it is worthwhile.
quality.above: In line with the recommended threshold.
quality.stale: The ad changed after this analysis.
quality.highlighted: Vague phrases are underlined in the preview: open them for the rewrite.

publish.disabledHint: Complete the missing items to publish.
publish.belowTitle: The ad is below the recommended threshold
publish.belowBody: Score {total} out of {max}; the recommended threshold is {threshold}. The score flags, it never blocks: you can publish anyway.
publish.doneBody: It is now visible to everyone at:
publish.noAnalysis: The quality analysis could not run, but the ad was published.
publish.liveBody: It is now on the careers page, with salary and process in plain sight. Share the address wherever you look for people.

actions.cannotSave: Fix the flagged fields before saving.
actions.closeBody: The ad will disappear from the careers page and can neither be edited nor reopened.
actions.templateNameHint: A name that helps you find it later, for example “Senior backend”.

templates.title: Templates
templates.subtitle: Ad models to start from.
templates.empty: No templates yet. Save an ad as a template from the editor.
templates.emptyBody: A template keeps the salary, process and requirements of an ad that works. Open an ad in the editor and choose “Save as template”.
templates.useFor: Create an ad from the template {name}
templates.deleteBody: The template “{name}” will be deleted. Ads already created do not change.
templates.loadFailed: We could not load the templates.
templates.forbidden: You do not have permission to see templates.

public.onsiteDays: 1 day a week on site | {count} days a week on site
public.processIntro: These are the stages, in the order you will go through them.
public.responseValue: You will hear back within 1 day after each stage. | You will hear back within {count} days after each stage.
public.footer: Here salary, selection process and response times are always declared.

careers.title: Open positions at {organization}
careers.subtitle: Every ad tells you the pay, how we select, and when you will hear back.
careers.metaDescription: Open positions at {organization}: salary, work mode and selection process always stated.
careers.empty: There are no open positions right now.
careers.emptyBody: When we open one, you will find it here with salary, process and response times already written.
careers.count: No open positions | 1 open position | {count} open positions
careers.notFound: This careers page does not exist.

stats.response: day at most for an answer | days at most for an answer

filters.label: Filter by work mode
filters.noMatch: No positions with this work mode.

job.response: answer in 1 day | answer in {count} days

promise.label: Product principles
promise.lead: {name} is an open source ATS on the candidate's side.

salary.title: Salary in the clear.
salary.body: A job ad without a salary range cannot be published.

process.title: A declared process.
process.body: Stages, who runs them, how long they take and when you hear back, all visible before applying.

answer.title: Every candidate gets an answer.
answer.body: No application is left without an outcome, and no decision about people is automated.

promise.footer: Open code, full export at any time.

errorPage.notFoundBody: The link may be old or contain a typo.
errorPage.unreachableBody: We cannot reach the server right now. Try again in a moment.
errorPage.genericBody: We logged the problem. Try again, or go back to the start.
